confirmed_original_source_definitions.original_micro_candidate_objective: Maximum past-period hit races per unchanged point count, tie fewer changes, then reference, then lexical

confirmed_original_source_definitions.hundredfold_hit_race_definition: At least one purchased winning trifecta pays at least 10,000 yen per 100 yen; ties count once per race
confirmed_original_source_definitions.original_5000_yen_comparison_scope: 141 races with stored purchase-time odds, separate from annual flat-100 comparison
